meta.name: CCNL Metalmeccanica e Installazione di Impianti — Artigianato

notes.text: CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: base_salary values are conglobated minimum pay figures, incorporating base pay, contingenza and EDR in a single amount. Conglobation confirmed in force from 16.06.2011 (source: EBNA CCNL 17.12.2021, Art. 28 and attached tables). fixed_allowances is empty for all levels.

2022 TRANCHES: three tranches CCNL 17.12.2021 (01.01.2022, 01.05.2022, 01.12.2022). Per-level increments verified against EBNA/Direzionelavoro.it. Values at 01.12.2022 confirmed from EBNA primary source.
AFAC TRANCHES: Accordo Fondo Anticipazione Contrattuale 21.12.2023, two tranches (01.12.2023, 01.04.2024). Values at 01.04.2024 cross-verified against kitech.it for all 8 levels.

2024 RENEWAL TRANCHES: agreement 19.11.2024 (operative 20.12.2024), four tranches (01.12.2024, 01.07.2025, 01.03.2026, 01.11.2026). All per-level amounts for all 8 levels confirmed from UILM national synthesis PDF (20250128 CCNL Artigianato area meccanica 2023-2026, url: https://www.uilmnazionale.it/). Values match kitech.it for levels verified there. All 4 tranches fully modelled with primary-source amounts.

HOURLY DIVISOR: 173 hours/month (40h/week, Art. 28 CCNL 17.12.2021). Arithmetic monthly/hourly verification did not yield clean integer results on the available values; confirmation is based on the primary CCNL text.

SENIORITY INCREMENTS: biennial, at most 5, fixed amounts of Art. 60 and 71 for the workers without a scatto on 27 November 1997 (EBNA text pp. 135-136, 143-145). Workers with earlier scatti keep the 5% mechanism and the maxima at 30 June 2000 (181,79 for the Primo livello to 101,22 for the Sesto), not modelled.

APPRENTICESHIP percentage, 10 semesters (60 months max), operai progression (source EBLART, apprenticeship professionalizzante article): 70% (sem. I-II), 75% (III), 78% (IV), 80% (V), 85% (VI), 88% (VII), 92% (VIII), 100% (IX-X); track 'operai' for destinations 5, 4, 3, 2bis. Since the 2015 reform level 6° cannot be used as a destination.

INPS OPERAI/IMPIEGATI: 2026-artigianato.json models both categories via employer_rate_by_category (operai default 26.93%; impiegati/quadri 24.71%). Pass Employee(category='impiegato') or Employee(category='quadro') to receive the lower rate; omitting category routes to operaio rate. Components: IVS 23.81% + NASpI 1.61% + CUAF 0.68% + malattia operai ~0.83% = 26.93%; malattia for impiegati is lower (hence ~24.71%). No CIGO/CIGS (D.Lgs. 148/2015 Art. 3, artigianato excluded). FSBA (0.45% employer + 0.15% employee) is bilateral, excluded from the tax file.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima). A quattordicesima is not provided for by the CCNL Artigianato Metalmeccanico.

APPRENTICESHIP administrative impiegati (destination levels 2, 1): 3 years, percentages 70% (year 1), 77% (year 2), 87% (year 3), 100% thereafter. Track 'impiegati'. Level 1Q (quadro) excluded. Source: CCNL metalmeccanico artigianato renewal 17.12.2021 (EBLART summary); formazione-apprendistato.com; conflavoro.it 2021 summary.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: apprentices accrue no scatti before 1 January 2025; from that date they accrue scatti of 10 euro each, not scaled by the apprentice percentage, on the cadence of the other workers, and those in service on that date accrue from it ('la maturazione dell'anzianità di servizio ai fini del riconoscimento degli scatti decorre da pari data', Art. 27 as renewed on 19 November 2024, signed scan p. 6). At the end of the apprenticeship the matured scatti are revalued to the amount of the final level.

INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (artigianato) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the artigianato rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (artigianato) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles whether the 0.91 NASpI reduction of the artisan employers also applies to apprentices, nor the wage-integration contribution they owe (the FSBA is paid outside INPS). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of artigianato (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/artigianato.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: TERM: the renewal of 19 November 2024 runs from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2026 (Art. 2, signed scan) and keeps applying until the next renewal takes effect; the tabellare of 1 November 2026 stays in force after 2026 until a renewal is read.

APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 27 as renewed on 19 November 2024, signed scan p. 6, by semester on the retribuzione tabellare of the destination level): operai of the 1st and 2nd group 70, 70, 75, 78, 80, 85, 88, 92, 100, 100%; impiegati amministrativi 70, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90%; impiegati centralinisti 70, 70, 75, 80%, not modelled apart (their destination level is not distinguished).

HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS (EBNA text, Art. 11-12, pp. 30-32): bilateralità artigiana 11,65 euro a month for 12 months from the employer, also for part-time and apprentices, plus FSBA 0,45% from the employer and 0,15% from the worker of the INPS base (from 1 January 2022), or 30 euro a month for 13 months paid to the worker by a firm outside the bilateral system; San.Arti 10,42 euro a month for 12 months from the employer, or an E.a.r. of 25 euro a month for 13 months when the firm does not enrol. Not modelled: the worker's 0,15% lowers the net pay.

limitation.remediation: Pass the contributions as bilateral fund events, or model them per worker.

notes.text: SATURDAY OVERTIME AND ORDINARY NIGHT AND HOLIDAY WORK: in a five-day week Saturday overtime is paid 25% for the first 3 hours and 50% after; ordinary night work is paid 15% and holiday work 45% (Art. 22, p. 84). The request has no Saturday kind and the bands hold only the overtime rates.

limitation.remediation: Add a Saturday kind with the 3-hour threshold, and bands for ordinary night and holiday work.

notes.text: SICKNESS OF THE IMPIEGATI: Art. 73 (p. 147) pays the impiegati the whole pay for 2 months and half for the next 4 up to 5 years of service, the whole for 3 months and half for the next 5 above; the file applies the operai rule of Art. 61.

limitation.remediation: Model the Art. 73 bands for the impiegati by category.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: the tabellare of the Metalmeccanica ed Installazione di Impianti sector for the four tranches of the renewal of 19 November 2024 (verbale integrativo of 25 November 2024), and the term; comparison with the industrial CCNL.
findings: The 32 tabellari of the four tranches (1 December 2024 to 1 November 2026, eight levels) match the signed table of p. 27: verified.
The tabellare 'fino al 30 novembre 2024' (with the AFAC of 21 December 2023) matches the period from 1 April 2024; its start date is not in this scan and stays derived.
Term: 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2026, then until the next renewal (Art. 2). review_due 2027-01-31.

The tredicesima is stated in the new unified article of the renewal (p. 16) and no quattordicesima appears: the number of monthly payments, 13, moves from assumed to derived (the period starts in 2022, before the renewal).

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL C030 matches (the Confartigianato and CNA categories, Casartigiani, CLAAI with FIM, FIOM, UILM).
Term: 'Il presente CCNL decorre dal 1° gennaio 2023 e avrà validità fino al 31 dicembre 2026' (Art. 2), the same in the report.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'scatti di anzianità, indennità e altri elementi fissi': the scatti and fixed allowances of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The renewal of 19 November 2024 (Art. 27, p. 6) gives apprentices scatti of 10 euro from 1 January 2025, accrued from that date also by apprentices already in service, so none before: the apprentice_seniority limitation is resolved with seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0.00 until 2024 and 10.00 from 2025.
The per-level scatti amounts (1Q 32,94 to 6 18,40), the 24-month cadence and the 5-scatti maximum are not restated in the renewal: they stay derived from the 2021 text.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili': the overtime bands and the night, holiday and shift premiums of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The overtime rates could not be read from a party text: the EBNA copy of the 2021 CCNL returns an HTML page and the 2024 renewal does not restate them. A summary (direzionelavoro, p. 3) adds Saturday overtime at 25% for the first 3 hours and 50% after, not modelled, and other summaries give night overtime at 55% against the 45% of the file. Runs with overtime are blocked until the article is read.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova': the apprenticeship tracks and the part-time supplementary hours of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The operai track matches the ten semesters of Art. 27 (p. 6). The impiegati track paid yearly averages (77% for months 13-24, 87% for months 25-36): the text pays 75, 80, 85 and 90% by semester. Corrected.
The 24-month track of the centralinisti (70, 70, 75, 80%) is not modelled apart: noted.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the pension, health and bilateral contributions of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: No pension, health or bilateral contribution is modelled; EBNA, FSBA, San.Arti and the pension fund are declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'scatti di anzianità, indennità e altri elementi fissi', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Scatti: the eight amounts, the 24-month cadence and the maximum of 5 match Art. 60 and 71 for the workers hired after 27 November 1997: verified. The pre-1998 mechanism is noted.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Art. 22 (p. 84): straordinario 25% and straordinario festivo 45% match; straordinario notturno is 55%, not 45%: corrected; the rates apply to the retribuzione di fatto (hourly base gross_incl_allowances) and do not cumulate (night holiday 55%). The unconfirmed-rates limitation is resolved; the Saturday rule and the ordinary night and holiday work are declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'ferie, permessi, festività, assenze, malattia e comporto', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Sickness of the operai (Art. 61, pp. 137-138): top-up to 100% of the net pay from the fourth day (from the first past 7 days), for at most 150 days; the file paid 100% from the first day for 180 days: corrected. The impiegati rule of Art. 73 (p. 147) is declared by category.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the amounts of the declared contributions, read on the full text published by a party.
findings: Bilateralità 11,65 euro a month, FSBA 0,45% + 0,15%, San.Arti 10,42 euro a month and the E.a.r. of 30 and 25 euro read on pp. 30-32: the declared limitation now states every amount.
